description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetStreamVariable, which implements a method to read a stream variable from a filename. It is part of the Smarty templating engine's internal plugin system, providing functionality to retrieve stream variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetStreamVariable
classes.description: A class providing the implementation of Smarty's internal method for getting stream variables, allowing reading the contents of a stream variable from a file.

methods.name: getStreamVariable
methods.description: Reads the contents of a stream variable (file) specified by its filename, returning the contents or throwing an exception if the variable cannot be accessed.
